title: The Dupatta That Owned the Front Seat

beats.theme: the aunty who reserves the front seat with a dupatta
beats.setting: top-down inside the pool car's cabin, narrated like a wildlife documentary
beats.conflict: three passengers come out earlier each week and the front seat is always already claimed
beats.failedAttempt: a coin toss at the gate where every coin rolls into the drain
beats.twist: the dupatta is Kapoor aunty's: she isn't in the carpool, she rides two stops to the market
beats.lesson: if nobody knows who's in your carpool, the dupatta decides
beats.appAngle: a pool with named members gives the stowaway her own driving turn; skip today frees her seat

beats.ctaLine: If a dupatta owns your front seat

lines.text: Your carpool lost its front seat for 15 mornings to a dupatta nobody's ever seen.
Observe the carpool, in its natural habitat.
One driver. Three passengers. One front seat.
Week one. Rohan, eight sharp. A dupatta's already there.
Folded. Polite.
Week two. Priya, seven sharp, with her own cushion. Dupatta. Plus a steel tiffin.
Week three. Sharma ji, early for once. Dupatta, tiffin, flask of chai.
Still warm.
So the back seat settles it like adults. Coin toss.
Rohan flips. The coin rolls under the car. Into the drain.
Best of three. Two more coins. Same drain.
Then the guard walks over. That's Kapoor aunty's.
Kapoor aunty is not in the carpool.
She rides two stops to the vegetable market. Front seat.
Arjun thought she was Priya's aunt. Priya thought, Arjun's.
Lesson: if nobody knows who's in your carpool, the dupatta decides.
Fix? A real pool, inside an app. Four names. Then five.
Kapoor aunty joined, and the roster gave her a driving turn.
Market closed? One tap on skip today, front seat free.
Thursday. Kapoor aunty drives.
The dupatta now reserves the driver's seat.
If a dupatta owns your front seat, try Sahyatri.
